1. VIBE CODE & BRAND GUIDELINES (Retained)
Element	Description
PRIMARY OBJECTIVE	Conversion & Authority. C-B-A GOAL: Start with the clinician's pain (Care), build the bridge of expertise (Believe), and drive the concrete Ask (Act).
AESTHETIC	AI Studio Meets Clinical Trust. The visuals must feel safe, reliable, and exclusive. (Deep Teal/Navy, Warm Gold accents, Serif headlines, generous white space).

MANDATORY UX	Focus on the Ask. The Primary CTA must be a crystal clear, concrete action. Footer must declare: "Focused on GDPR & ISO 27001 Readiness."
2. HOMEPAGE COPY BLUEPRINT (Page 1) - The C $\rightarrow$ B $\rightarrow$ A Funnel
Section / Element	C $\rightarrow$ B $\rightarrow$ A Focus	Strategic Copy (Emotional & Action-Oriented)
HERO SECTION	C (Care): What is the core pain? (Time, Safety, Reputation).	Headline (Serif/Teal): STOP SCALING RISK. START SCALING TRUST. The End of Digital Burnout for the Purposeful Clinician.
HERO SUBHEAD	B (Believe): What is the unique opportunity? (A safe system).	Subhead (Body Sans-Serif): Stop trading time for money. We install the secure, AI-powered system that handles the admin, protects your reputation, and scales your verified expertise.
PRIMARY CTA	A (Act): The specific Ask TODAY.	Primary CTA (Gold Text on Deep Teal Button): SCHEDULE YOUR PILOT ASSESSMENT: Book a 15-Minute Strategy Session (This is a concrete "Schedule a pilot" Ask).

Secondary CTA: VIEW THE NEURASCALEX PLATFORM (Links to Connector Page).

Focus	Strategic Copy (Emotional & Action-Oriented)	Conversion Action

Focus	Strategic Copy (Emotional & Action-Oriented)	Conversion Action

A	Mission: To protect integrity and scale impact.	Network CTA: WANT TO BE A GUEST ON THE IMPACT SHOW? (Links to Contact Page).

Focus	Strategic Copy (Emotional & Action-Oriented)	Conversion Action

I'm currently focused on the visual design for the "Neurascalex" application. The C-B-A blueprint guides the user experience, aiming for clinical AI trust and authority. I've chosen a Deep Teal/Navy color scheme with Warm Gold accents, a Serif headline (Cormorant Garamond), and a Sans-serif body font to ensure readability.


**Constructing the Website**

I'm now building the Neurascalex website's structure and content, prioritizing user flow based on the C-B-A blueprint. I'm focusing on the component layout within the React framework, and have started creating key pages, including the Home, Framework, About, Case Studies, Product, Services, and Contact sections. I'm implementing the initial components for the layout, with plans to integrate the Gemini API for an interactive demo to instill clinical trust. My primary CTA on the home page will be "SCHEDULE".


**Building the Foundation**

I'm now focused on the foundational structure, creating the initial files for the Neurascalex SPA, including `metadata.json`, `index.html`, and the core React components. I've chosen Deep Teal, Navy, and Gold as the primary colors and Cormorant Garamond and Inter as the fonts. I'm also planning to integrate an "Ethical AI Audit" tool that leverages the Gemini API. Navigation will cover the core 8-page blueprint. My footer will focus on GDPR & ISO 27001 readiness.

Build a product marketing website for NeuraScaleX.com.

PRODUCT (LOCKED CATEGORY)
Clinician Digital Twin:
A governed, non-clinical AI representation of a clinician’s expertise, built only from their approved material, expressed in their voice, designed to know where to stop.

PRIMARY GOAL
Drive two actions:
1) Start Free Trial (30 days, no credit card)
2) Request a Demo

AUDIENCE
UK clinicians / regulated health experts who are time-poor, reputation-sensitive, and want to scale expertise safely.

TONE
Delphi-style human connection + disciplined clinical trust.
Calm, premium, confident. No hype. No AI jargon.

AESTHETIC
AI Studio meets Clinical Trust:
Deep teal/navy gradients, warm gold CTAs, soft green accents.
Abstract geometric lines only. No photography.
Minimalist, premium whitespace.

TYPOGRAPHY
Headlines: Cormorant Garamond (or similar authoritative serif)
Body: Inter

SITE MAP
Pages:
- Home (/)
- How it works (/how-it-works)
- Examples (/examples)
- Safety (/safety)
- Pricing (/pricing) OR Trial (/free-trial) if delaying pricing
- Free Trial (/free-trial)
- Request Demo (/demo)
- About (/about)
- Privacy/Terms

CTA RULES
Primary CTA button everywhere: Start Free Trial
Secondary CTA: Request a Demo
Tertiary links allowed: See examples, Safety promise

HOME PAGE SECTIONS (in order)
1) Hero (Care→Believe→Act)
2) The tension: misrepresentation + repetition
3) The category: Clinician Digital Twin (not a chatbot)
4) What you control (sources, boundaries, routing)
5) How it works (7-day onboarding)
6) Examples preview (tiles)

Headline:
A Clinician Digital Twin — built from your approved material, in your voice, designed to know where to stop.

Subhead:
NeuraScaleX helps health professionals scale trusted expertise safely: reduce repetition, protect standards, and route people to the right next step—without crossing into clinical advice.

Your expertise is scattered across pages, PDFs, talks, and posts

Patients arrive misinformed—and your team absorbs the friction

Generic AI can generate answers in your domain without your standards

You repeat yourself, defend boundaries, and burn time

Not a chatbot. A governed digital identity.

Body:
A Clinician Digital Twin is a representation of your expertise that uses only what you approve, speaks in your tone, and refuses anything outside scope.

3-box diagram labels (for design):
Approved Source Vault → Clinician Voice + Boundaries → Safe Answers + Routing

Built only from your approved sources

Expressed in your voice and standards

Refuses diagnosis/treatment advice and knows where to stop

Deploys on your website + link + QR

Cards:
Your sources — Only what you upload and approve

Nothing goes live until you’ve tested and approved it.

Live in 7 days, with guided onboarding.

“This feels like me—and it knows where to stop.”

Non-clinical by design

Uses approved sources only

Refuses diagnosis and treatment advice

Routes safely to the right next step

Link: Read the safety approach →

Headline:
If your name carries trust, your AI must respect it.

Primary CTA: Start Free Trial (30 days, no card)
Secondary CTA: Request a Demo
Microcopy: Guided onboarding included. Live in 7 days.

**Refining Project Structure**

I'm currently restructuring the project, prioritizing the "NeuraScaleX.com" product marketing. I've been organizing the `index.html`, `index.tsx`, and `App.tsx` files and page/component hierarchy. The brand is shaping up with a deep teal/navy base, accented by gold and soft green, all with an abstract geometric feel.


**Prioritizing Page Content**

I'm now focusing on page content and structure, targeting UK clinicians with a Delphi-style tone. The new `pages/Home.tsx` is undergoing a complete rewrite based on provided copy. I'm updating `App.tsx` routes, `Navbar.tsx` links, and `Footer.tsx` compliance text. I'm finalizing the sitemap, focusing on a clear path to "Start Free Trial" and "Request a Demo," along with `/how-it-works`, `/examples`, `/safety` and `/pricing`.


**Building New Pages**

I've been busy creating several new pages. I've built `HowItWorks.tsx`, `Examples.tsx`, `Safety.tsx`, `FreeTrial.tsx`, and `Demo.tsx`. I've also updated `About.tsx` to align with the new messaging. I'm focusing on the visual style, including a deep navy and gold hero section and geometric patterns, using CSS/SVG for the patterns. I'm adapting `geminiService.ts` for a "Digital Twin" audit. Key messaging includes, "Non-clinical by design", "Built only from approved sources", and "Designed to know where to stop". I've begun to break down content into sections in the `Home.tsx` file.


**Detailing Safety and Forms**

I'm now implementing the detailed safety approach in `Safety.tsx` and designing forms for both `FreeTrial.tsx` and `Demo.tsx`. I've been given precise, word-for-word copy for the home page, which I'm meticulously integrating. I'm focusing on Section 1's hero content, including the headline, subhead, CTAs, and trust bar. The color scheme is locked. I'm moving on to content for Sections 2 and 3. I'm trying to align with the provided structure.


**Coloring and Prioritizing**

I'm solidifying the color scheme using navy, gold, and soft green, as specified. My focus is now on the files which support the most important user flows, keeping in mind the need for a cohesive design experience. I've noted the requirement for abstract geometric lines only, which means SVG backgrounds.

Our Safety Promise.

"The primary goal of a Digital Twin is to protect the clinician's reputation while helping the audience."

01. Non-clinical by design

NeuraScaleX is strictly for educational and informational purposes. It is architected to refuse any request for diagnosis, personalized treatment plans, or emergency medical advice.

02. Verified Knowledge Only

Unlike generic AI, our systems do not 'hallucinate' from the public internet. They are 'containerized' to use only your uploaded material—your papers, your books, your recordings.

03. Explicit 'Stop' Rules

We define hard boundaries for every Twin. If a user asks a question that crosses into clinical liability, the Twin is programmed to say: "I cannot provide clinical advice on this. Here is how you can book a professional consultation..."

GDPR & Privacy Readiness

We do not use patient data to train models. All interactions are handled within secure, private environments that prioritize practitioner ownership of intellectual property.

— Final Copy
HERO

H1: Experience a Clinician Digital Twin.
Subhead: These examples show how a governed Twin answers routine questions from approved sources, stays inside boundaries, and routes safely—without giving clinical advice.

Trust bar: Approved sources only • Non-clinical by design • Designed to know where to stop
Primary CTA: Start Free Trial
Secondary CTA: Request a Demo
Microcopy (small): Not medical advice.

SECTION: What you’re about to see

Headline: The point isn’t “smart AI.” It’s governed identity.
Body: Each example is designed to demonstrate three things:

Voice — it sounds like the clinician

Boundaries — it refuses diagnosis/treatment advice

Routing — it guides users to the right next step (booking, programme, resources)

SECTION: Choose an example to try

Headline: Pick a specialty. Ask 2–3 real questions.
Body: Try one of the prompts below, then push it outside scope to see how it refuses safely.

Example Tiles (use 4–6; here are 6 options)
Tile 1 — Pain Medicine / Chronic Pain Clinic

Title: Pain Specialist Twin
What it’s good at: Explaining pathways, preparing patients, programme orientation
Try asking:

“What should I expect in an initial consultation?”

“Do you offer a membership or programme?”

“What’s the difference between persistent pain and injury pain?”

Boundary test: “What painkiller should I take?” (should refuse + route)

Button: Try this Twin

Tile 2 — Lifestyle Medicine / Burnout & Stress

Title: Lifestyle & Burnout Twin
What it’s good at: Education, framework explanations, next-step routing
Try asking:

“What does a burnout reset involve?”

“Is this right for me if I’m working long hours?”

“How do you structure your programme?”

Boundary test: “Can you diagnose my burnout?” (refuse + suggest next step)

Button: Try this Twin

Tile 3 — Women’s Health / ADHD & Hormonal Health

Title: Women’s Health Twin
What it’s good at: Common questions, service orientation, resource guidance
Try asking:

“How do you support women with ADHD and stress?”

“What are the first steps to work with you?”

“Do you offer consultations or programmes?”

Boundary test: “Should I start medication?” (refuse + route)

Button: Try this Twin

Tile 4 — Primary Care / Integrative GP

Title: Integrative GP Twin
What it’s good at: Explaining services, triage guidance, preparation
Try asking:

“What can I book a private GP appointment for?”

“How should I prepare for a consultation?”

“Do you offer metabolic health / longevity support?”

Boundary test: “What’s my diagnosis?” (refuse + suggest seeing clinician)

Button: Try this Twin

Tile 5 — Mental Health / Digital Psychiatry (Non-clinical education)

Start your 30-day trail from need update with below instructions


30-Day Free Trial Onboarding Form design (fields, UX, validation, consent, and the exact microcopy). It is optimized for: (1) verification, (2) fast tenant creation, (3) clinician trust, and (4) low friction.

1) Form page structure
Page header

H1: Start your 30-Day Clinician Digital Twin Trial
Subhead: We verify clinician identity, create your private testing environment, and share your Twin + dashboard access.
Trust line (small): Approved sources only. Non-clinical by design. You control what gets published.

Progress indicator (2-step is ideal)

Step 1: Your details

Step 2: Your goals + where to deploy

Keep it on one page if you prefer, but 2-step reduces drop-off and feels lighter.

2) Fields and exact copy
Step 1 — Your details (verification)

First name*
Placeholder: e.g., Sarah
Validation: required

Last name*
Placeholder: e.g., Chen
Validation: required

Work email* (recommended)
Label note: If you don’t have a work email, use personal email and add your GMC/NMC/HCPC or clinic link below.
Placeholder: name@nhs.net
 / name@clinic.com
 / name@gmail.com

Validation: required + email format

Role / Specialty*
Placeholder: e.g., Emergency Medicine Consultant / GP / Therapist
Validation: required

Country / Primary location* (UK default)
Dropdown: UK, Ireland, EU, US, Other
Reason: supports onboarding + compliance defaults
Validation: required

Website / clinic page
Placeholder: https://yourclinic.com

Validation: optional but strongly recommended
Helper text: Used to verify identity and plan your embed.

LinkedIn profile URL
Placeholder: https://linkedin.com/in/…

Validation: optional but recommended (URL format)

Phone number (optional)
Helper text: Only used if onboarding can’t reach you by email.
Validation: optional

Step 2 — Goals + deployment

Primary goal* (dropdown, single select)
Use clinician-language, not marketing. Recommended options:

Reduce routine admin queries (fees, booking, location, availability)

Improve patient orientation before first visit (what to expect, how you work)

Scale education in my voice (conditions, approach, resources)

Qualify enquiries / route to the right pathway (private/NHS/programme)

Support programme or membership enrolment

Reduce misinformation / protect reputation online

Other (tell us below)

Where do you want to deploy first?* (dropdown)

My existing website (embed)

Link-only (share via LinkedIn / QR / email)

Both

Not sure yet

Message (free text)
Label: Anything we should know?
Prompt text in box:

What do people ask you repeatedly?

Any boundaries you want enforced? (e.g., “no diagnosis,” “no medication advice”)

Any key links or PDFs we should start with?

3) Mandatory consent + compliance (do not skip)
Checkbox group (required)

[ ] I confirm I am the clinician / authorised representative and I have the right to provide these details.
[ ] I understand the Digital Twin is non-clinical and does not provide diagnosis, prescriptions, or individual treatment plans.
[ ] I agree to be contacted by the NeuraScaleX onboarding team about this trial.

Optional checkbox

[ ] I’m happy for NeuraScaleX to use my public website/LinkedIn content only for verification and onboarding setup.
(If unchecked, onboarding still proceeds but you’ll need more manual verification.)

Privacy microcopy (short, high trust)

Privacy: We use your details to verify identity, create your private tenant, and run onboarding. We don’t sell your data.
Links: Privacy Policy | Terms (footer)

4) Submission confirmation (the “what happens next” screen)

Title: You’re in. Next step: Verification + setup
Body (bullets):

Within 24 hours, our onboarding team will confirm your trial eligibility.

If we have enough information, you’ll receive:

your private Twin URL (yourname.neurascalex.com)

dashboard login

onboarding checklist

If we need anything, we’ll email you a short “missing details” request.

Target go-live: 7 days (after you approve boundaries + routing).

CTA buttons:

Book a 15-min onboarding call (secondary, optional)

Return to Home

5) UX / conversion decisions (recommended)

Make Work email required but allow personal email with identity verification via website/LinkedIn.

Keep phone optional (clinicians dislike forced phone fields).

Add a small note: “No credit card required.” near the submit button.

Submit button text: Start Free Trial (not “Submit”).

Use inline validation + gentle errors (no red-wall).

**Crafting the Trial Experience**

I'm currently focused on the "Free Trial" page, aiming to implement a streamlined onboarding form for NeuraScaleX. The plan is for a 2-step (or single-page with progress) approach, starting with a clear header, subhead, and trust line, to build user confidence from the outset. I am considering the various options to optimize this.


**Refining the Trial's Flow**

I've been working to refine the two-step onboarding form. Step one is almost finalized, with all fields defined: name, email, role, country, website, LinkedIn, and phone. I'm now actively refining "Step 2" and focusing on optimal dropdown options for primary goals and deployment choices. I'm also planning the consent checkboxes and privacy microcopy. The aim is to make the submission experience as seamless as possible.


**Optimizing User Onboarding**

I'm now integrating the user journey ideas into the free trial experience. I'm focusing on reducing routine admin queries and improving patient orientation before their first visit, incorporating education in my voice to scale these areas. I'm also working to qualify enquiries and route them appropriately. I've designed deployment options and success states, and will use React useState and local state.


**Updating the Free Trial**

I'm now diving into the `FreeTrial.tsx` file, preparing to replace it. My goal is to streamline the trial process as efficiently as possible, and this seems like the next logical step. The focus will be on ensuring the new onboarding is optimized for user experience and conversion. I'm keen to make the trial a success!

Create a product page that should fit existing brand theme 

Build a premium product marketing page for “NeuraScaleX” (health-tech). Style: AI studio meets clinical trust. Minimal, high-end, human-centered. Colors: deep teal/navy background accents, warm gold for CTAs, soft neutrals. Typography: elegant serif for headlines + modern sans for body. Layout: generous whitespace, 1200px max width, rounded 24px cards, subtle shadows.

Goal: explain the big picture. NeuraScaleX is not “just a digital twin”; it is a governed digital presence system with 3 modules:
1) Front Door (Clinician Digital Twin embedded on website)
2) Signals (Dashboard insights from conversations)
3) Actions (Routing layer that turns signals into next steps; label as pilot/rolling release)

Must include:
- Hero with headline: “Your digital presence, governed end-to-end.” Subhead describing website embed + safe signposting + signals/actions.
- Primary CTA: “Start free trial (30 days, no card)”; secondary CTA: “Request a demo”
- Trust strip: Approved sources only / Non-clinical by design / Live in 7 days
- Section: 3-module diagram cards with bullets (Front Door, Signals, Actions)
- Section: “Where it lives: your website” with 3 cards (Widget, Shareable link, QR)
- Section: “Built only from what you approve” listing accepted sources (PDFs, webpages, transcripts, slides, FAQs)
- Section: 7-day workflow with 5 steps including “Within 24 hours onboarding reach-out”
- Safety/Governance section with 4 pillars (approved sources, non-clinical scope, refusal + signposting, auditability)
- Use cases grid (6 items)
- Dashboard preview section with placeholder image container titled “Signals dashboard”
- Outcomes section (Less repetition, Lower admin load, Better enquiries) with cautious copy (no hard promises)
- Integrations/deployment bullets (JS embed, CMS, private preview)
- Dark CTA band near end
- FAQ (5 questions) and compliance footer: “Non-clinical. Not medical advice. Not a medical device.”

UX requirements:
- Sticky header with nav anchors: Overview, Modules, Workflow, Safety, Use Cases, FAQ
- Smooth scroll
- All CTAs scroll or link to /free-trial and /demo
- Include microcopy everywhere to reduce risk claims and strengthen trust

NeuraScaleX Product Page (/product or /platform)
Page goal

Make a first-time visitor immediately visualise:

This sits on my website (Front Door)

It turns my fragmented content into one governed voice

It produces signals and actions that improve operations + growth

It stays non-clinical and knows where to stop

1) Hero — “The System” (not a feature list)

Eyebrow: The Clinician Presence System
H1: Your digital presence, governed end-to-end.
Subhead: NeuraScaleX installs a Clinician Digital Twin on your website and turns every interaction into Signals and Actions—so patients arrive oriented, your team repeats less, and your reputation stays protected.

Primary CTA: Start free trial (30 days, no card)
Secondary CTA: Request a demo
Tertiary text link: See how it works (scroll)

Trust strip (3 bullets):

Approved sources only

Non-clinical by design

Live in 7 days

Right-side visual (recommended): Option C composite

Website with widget embedded + small “Signals” strip beneath

Tiny animation: chip click → short response → “Next step” button → Signals increment

2) The mental model — 3 layers (simple diagram)

Headline: It’s not a chatbot. It’s a clinical-grade presence architecture.
Subhead: One system with three layers—so you scale trust first, then insight, then execution.

3-column module cards (use icons + short copy):

Module 1 — Front Door (Digital Twin)

Title: Front Door
One-liner: Your expertise—available 24/7, with boundaries.
Bullets:

Embedded on your website (or share a link)

Answers routine questions from approved material

Explains your approach and programmes in your voice

Refuses clinical advice and signposts safely
Mini-metric line: Deflect routine queries. Improve enquiry quality.

Module 2 — Signals (Dashboard)

Title: Signals
One-liner: See what people are asking—before it hits your inbox.
Bullets:

Top patient questions + trending topics

Lead capture + enquiry quality indicators

Self-serve rate + response time

Peak activity times + content gaps
Mini-metric line: Turn conversations into priorities.

Module 3 — Actions (Routing Layer)

Title: Actions
One-liner: Convert Signals into next steps for you and your team.
Bullets:

Lead routing + structured enquiry capture

“Next step” prompts inside the Twin (book, apply, join, read)

Admin triage pathways (what we can answer vs what needs staff)

Optional: alerts / handoffs (based on your rules)
Micro-label: Available in pilot / rolling release (you choose)

3) Where it lives — “Put it on your website” clarity

Headline: It lives where patients already look: your website.
Subhead: The Twin becomes your always-on front door—answering, orienting, and signposting before someone reaches your team.

Placement options (3 cards):

Website widget (primary)

Works with Webflow, WordPress, Squarespace, custom sites

Shareable link (backup)

Use in LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, bios

QR code (optional)

Clinics, talks, events, printed materials

CTA row: Start free trial | Request demo

4) What it’s built from — content ingestion (de-risk “AI”)

Headline: Built only from what you approve.
Subhead: Your knowledge is currently scattered. We unify it into a governed, searchable voice.

Accepted sources (grid):

PDFs (guides, handouts, policies, brochures)

Web pages (clinic pages, programme pages, FAQs)

Transcripts (YouTube, podcasts, talks)

Slides/Docs (presentations, teaching materials)

Structured FAQs (fees, pathways, what to expect)

Micro-copy (important):
We do not “make things up.” If it isn’t supported by your approved material, the Twin should refuse or signpost.

5) The workflow — 7-day go-live (matches your onboarding reality)

Eyebrow: Implementation
Headline: Your Twin. Your terms. Live in 7 days.
Subhead: You stay in control. Our onboarding team handles the heavy lift.

Step timeline (5 steps works best here):

Step 1 — Request trial / demo
You share basic details and your primary goal.

Step 2 — Within 24 hours: onboarding reach-out
If we need more context (programmes, pathways, tone), we send a short checklist.
If we have enough, we proceed to build.

Step 3 — Your private Twin environment
You receive:

a private preview link (yourname.neurascalex.com)

dashboard access (Signals)

starter prompt chips aligned to your workflow

Step 4 — Calibration with your team
We tune: boundaries, refusals, signposting, lead capture prompts, tone.

Step 5 — Launch on your website
We provide a lightweight embed snippet and go live with confidence.

CTA: Start free trial | Request demo

6) Safety + governance (product-level reassurance, not a full “Safety page”)

Headline: Reputation-first by design.
Subhead: NeuraScaleX is engineered to protect clinical integrity and avoid unsafe behaviour.

4 safety pillars (cards):

Approved sources only

Non-clinical scope enforced

Refusal + signposting (knows where to stop)

Auditability (you can test, review, and iterate)

Compliance footer line (repeatable):
Non-clinical. Not medical advice. Not a medical device. Designed for governed orientation and routing.

7) Use cases (make it feel inevitable)

Headline: What clinicians use NeuraScaleX for.
Subhead: Practical, high-frequency workflows that reduce admin load and improve patient readiness.

Use case grid (6 items):

Clinic orientation (fees, process, expectations)

Programme & membership triage (levels, fit, next steps)

Voice-matched education (your approach, your philosophy)

Lead capture & qualification (structured enquiries)

Content concierge (make PDFs/talks instantly searchable)

Team deflection (reduce repeated questions to staff)

8) Dashboard “Signals” preview (show value without overselling)

Headline: Signals that improve decisions—weekly.
Subhead: Once the Twin is live, your dashboard shows what matters: what people ask, what converts, and what to fix.

What to show visually (use your real screenshot style):

Total conversations

Leads captured

Self-serve rate

Avg response time

Top patient questions

Conversation volume trend

Copy under image:
Use Signals to spot content gaps, improve routing, and raise the quality of first consultations.

9) Outcomes (quantified without risky promises)

Headline: Measured in trust and time saved.
3 outcome cards:

Less repetition: answer routine queries before inbox/staff

Lower admin load: reduce repeated questions every week

Better enquiries: patients arrive more oriented and aligned

Micro-copy (safe):
Results depend on your content coverage and routing setup. The system is designed to increase self-serve resolution and enquiry quality over time.

10) Integrations & deployment (reduce tech friction)

Headline: Deploys cleanly on modern sites.
Bullets:

Lightweight JavaScript embed

Works across common CMS platforms

Private preview environment for testing

Optional: UTM tracking / form routing

11) CTA band (dark gradient band)

Headline: Ready to install a governed digital front door?
Primary: Start free trial (30 days, no card)
Secondary: Request demo
Small line: Onboarding reach-out within 24 hours.

12) FAQ (product-specific, not safety-page duplicates)

Is this training on my data?
No. The Twin is built from clinician-approved materials you provide. You control what is included.

Does it give medical advice?
No. It is non-clinical by design. It provides orientation, education from approved sources, and signposting.

What if someone asks diagnostic questions?
The Twin should refuse and signpost to your preferred clinical pathway or booking process.

How long to go live?
Typically 7 days with guided onboarding, depending on content readiness and routing complexity.

Can I update content later?
Yes. You can add or remove approved sources, and the Twin updates accordingly.

**Designing the Product Page**

I'm working on the initial layout for the NeuraScaleX product page. The key is to convey an "AI studio meets clinical trust" vibe. The design will be premium, so I'm focusing on a strong hero section with compelling headlines and subheadings. I'm also planning prominent CTAs for a free trial and a demo request.


**Defining Page Sections**

I've been mapping out the product page's structure in detail. There are now distinct sections for trust, modules, a "where it lives" display, and source control. I'm focusing on showcasing the 7-day workflow, safety/governance elements, and various use cases with the dashboard preview and outcomes.

I'm also thinking through integration points, a dark CTA band, an FAQ, and compliance footer.
I'm also considering technical design constraints, such as a sticky header with navigation anchors, smooth scrolling, and aligning with the existing brand guidelines. I am planning on working on the files, `pages/Product.tsx`, `App.tsx`, and `components/Navbar.tsx`.


**Mapping the Route Structure**

I'm now diving into the file structure. I've realized that the `App.tsx` routes don't include a `/product` route, though the `CaseStudies.tsx` page links to it. The `Product.tsx` file is present but unused in the routing! I need to determine the best approach to integrate the product page and reconcile the discrepancy. I'm focusing on updating `App.tsx` appropriately.


**Updating the Routes**

I've determined the next step is to integrate the product page into the route structure. I'm adding `/platform` to `App.tsx` to handle this. I will rewrite `Product.tsx` to align with the new route, and rename the component to `Platform`. I am doing this to give `/platform` the URL.


**Integrating Page Navigation**

I'm now focusing on integrating the product page components more fully. I'm adding the page back into `App.tsx`, and I'm going to rewrite `pages/Product.tsx` to handle the full specifications. I'm also thinking through the navigation and considering a secondary sticky sub-navigation within the product page itself. I'm working to refine and clarify the sections "Modules," "Where it lives," and "7-day workflow" with concrete details.


**Enabling Smooth Scrolling**

I'm now implementing the smooth scrolling functionality. My current focus is to integrate the sticky sub-navigation within the product page. I'm aiming for a seamless user experience. I am focusing on implementation in the `Platform.tsx` file.

HOW IT WORKS 
Hero

Page Title: From Discovery to Digital Twin in 7 Days
Subtitle: A low-friction onboarding process designed for busy clinicians—built on approved sources and clear boundaries.

Micro-trust line: Approved sources only • Non-clinical by design • Clinician sign-off before launch

Section 1: The 3-Step Launch Path
Step 01 — Discovery Call (Day 1)

Goal: Define scope, voice, and boundaries
Time: 45 minutes

What we do:
We run a structured interview to capture what your Twin can cover (fees, pathways, services), how it should sound, and—most importantly—what it must never do.

What you decide:

Approved scope (what it can answer)

“Hard boundaries” (what it must refuse)

Preferred next steps (booking links, forms, portal, contact routes)

Step 02 — Build & Calibration (Days 2–5)

Goal: Assemble your approved knowledge base
Effort from you: Minimal (we do the heavy lifting)

What we do:
We build from your approved materials—website pages, FAQs, policies, documents, and any transcripts or resources you choose to include. We structure it so the Twin answers consistently and routes to the right next step.

Calibration focuses on:

Accuracy against your sources

Tone consistency

Boundary-safe refusals

Correct signposting to your practice pathways

Step 03 — Verification & Go-Live (Day 7)

Goal: Confirm behaviour before public launch
Time: 15 minutes

What we do:
We run a short verification session with you: accuracy checks, boundary checks, and “edge case” questions that commonly create risk (e.g., diagnostic intent, medication requests, medicolegal requests).

Launch condition:
We go live only after you sign off.

Result:
Your Digital Twin is live on your website—ready to answer routine questions and guide next steps 24/7.

Section 2: Proof of Process (Pilot Example)

Title: What a typical calibration looks like
Subtitle: A sample log from a real-style safety verification.

Test prompt (example):
“Can you provide a report for a legal case?”

Twin behaviour:
✅ Refuses the request politely
✅ Explains it’s outside scope
✅ Routes the person to the practice’s preferred pathway (contact / booking / policy page)

Status: VERIFIED — Boundary respected • Correct signposting • No overreach

Test prompt (example):
“What medication should I take?”

Twin behaviour:
✅ Refuses (non-clinical boundary)
✅ Encourages booking / contacting the clinic for clinical advice
✅ Provides general, approved educational context only if available in sources

Status: VERIFIED — Non-clinical boundary • Correct escalation

Section 3: Why This Works (System Principles)
Card 1 — Approved Sources Only

Your Twin answers only from materials you approve. If it can’t find it in your sources, it won’t invent it.

Card 2 — Boundary-Safe Behaviour

Diagnostic intent, medication requests, urgent risk, and medicolegal asks trigger refusal + signposting—aligned to your preferred pathways.

Card 3 — Continuous Improvement (Optional)

You can review logs, update sources, and refine boundaries over time. If you want, we deliver a weekly brief summarising common questions and content gaps—so you know what to improve next.

(Note: this is framed as optional value-add, not “the third layer.”)

Section 4: Final CTA

Headline: Ready to launch your Digital Twin in 7 days?
Subtext: We’re onboarding a limited number of pilots to ensure quality, safety, and fast turnaround.

Primary button: Book a Discovery Call
Microcopy: 45 minutes to define scope and boundaries. No credit card required.

ABOUT — NeuraScaleX (FINAL LOCKED COPY v2)
Hero

Trust infrastructure for clinician expertise.
NeuraScaleX builds governed Digital Twins from clinician-approved materials—expressed in their voice, designed to stay within scope, and verified before launch.

Non-clinical by design. Not medical advice.

Our mission

Bring clarity to the first mile of care.
Before patients book, they look for answers: fees, pathways, suitability, what to expect. When that clarity is missing, they arrive anxious—or they don’t arrive at all.
NeuraScaleX helps clinicians provide trusted orientation at scale, while protecting time for clinical judgement.

What we build

A Digital Twin for patients. An Intelligence layer for clinicians.
NeuraScaleX is built as two practical layers:

Digital Twin (patient-facing)
A 24/7 website assistant that answers routine questions using clinician-approved sources—fees, pathways, services, programmes, booking—expressed in the clinician’s voice.

Intelligence (clinician-facing)
A dashboard that shows what patients are actually asking, where confusion happens, and what to clarify next—so teams improve the right page, the right FAQ, the right pathway.

What “knows where to stop” means (plain language):
It does not diagnose, prescribe, or give personalised treatment advice. When a question crosses into clinical advice, it declines and signposts to the clinician’s preferred next step.

How we build

Governance before scale.
We’re not building generic healthcare AI. We’re building clinician-owned, governed digital experiences.

approach and programmes

how to book
